newsitem.title: UK: National Express lined up for Scotrail.
newsitem.headline: National Express lined up for Scotrail.

text.p: British public transport and airport operator National Express Group Plc has been picked as the preferred bidder for the large Scotrail train-operating company franchise, the government said on Monday.
In a statement the Office of Passenger Rail Franchising (Opraf) said it had chosen National Express and would be making a formal announcement detailing the contract soon.

The provisional award of the franchise, coming days after the award of the long-distance InterCity WestCoast franchise to Virgin Group, means only one franchise of the 25 that the government began privatising in 1995 is left to be awarded.
The choice of a preferred bidder for the Central Trains franchise is a straight battle between National Express and FirstBus Plc, Opraf said recently.
